name: Desktop Support
query: SELECT    U.full_name AS FullName,    I.case_owner,    SUM(CASE WHEN I.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Closed_Case,    I.subject AS SubjectFROM    `tabIssue` AS IJOIN    `tabUser` AS U ON I.case_owner = U.emailWHERE    I.issue_type = 'Desktop Support'    AND I.status = 'Closed'    AND U.enabled = 1    AND YEAR(I.date_and_time_closed) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)    AND MONTH(I.date_and_time_closed) = MONTH(CURDATE())GROUP BY    I.case_owner, U.full_name;
